# Markus Knauer — Robotics & AI Researcher

> Personal site of Markus Knauer, Research Scientist at the German Aerospace Center (DLR),
> Institute of Robotics and Mechatronics, and PhD candidate at the Technical University of
> Munich (TUM). Research: interactive robot skill learning, language-guided motion adaptation,
> continual learning, and foundation models for robotics.

## Projects
- [MOMO](https://markusknauer.github.io/projects/momo/): physical, verbal & graphical robot skill adaptation (IEEE RA-P 2026)
- [CLASP](https://markusknauer.github.io/projects/clasp/): language-driven robot skill selection and composition (ICRA 2026 Spotlight Award)
- [IROSA](https://markusknauer.github.io/projects/irosa/): interactive robot skill adaptation with natural language (ICRA 2026 Spotlight Award)
- [LOCI](https://markusknauer.github.io/projects/loci/): interactive incremental learning of robot skills (IEEE RA-L 2025)
- [RACCOON](https://markusknauer.github.io/projects/raccoon/): grounded embodied question-answering (IEEE ICRA 2025)
- [RECALL](https://markusknauer.github.io/projects/recall/): rehearsal-free continual learning (IEEE IROS 2022)
- [HOWS-CL-25](https://markusknauer.github.io/projects/hows-cl-25/): 150k-image household-objects dataset for continual learning
- [BlenderProc](https://markusknauer.github.io/projects/blenderproc/): photorealistic synthetic training data pipeline (3.4k+ GitHub stars)
